text:
maria: Quick async pulse — kernel + continuous-batching + KV sprint status? Need a short handoff list for Friday's milestone and to surface any blockers.

alex: pairing w/ kernel owners this morning. main blocker is the new attention kernel fallback path — causes a small p99 uplift under long-seq tests. tracking in PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/3821 :eyes:

trevor: I saw the regressions in staging too. CI trace shows kv cache misses spiking after the kernel change. logging below.

trevor: ```
kv_cache/miss_rate: 0.18 -> 0.46
latency/p99: 128ms -> 144ms (small sample)
command: ./run_perf.sh --model=sanity --seq=2048 --batch=4
```

jin: cc @alex @trevor — I repro'd locally, looks like the kernel's prefetch handshake timing made some hot prefixes miss the cache window. I have a draft fix to nudge prefetch earlier, will open PR today.

sasha: Ownership clarifications: who is primary for kernel fallback (rollout + revert)? who owns the KV tuning adjustments? we should avoid ping overlap during the canary.

alex: I own kernel fallback rollout (+revert plan). @jin take KV tuning lead for the prefetch timing change. @trevor you own the canary observation dashboard and will gate the rollout.

maria: perfect. timeline check — can we have PRs by EOD, canary tomorrow morning, and final decision by Friday 3pm?

jin: PR will be up in ~4hrs. I'll include the perf script and before/after numbers.

trevor: I'll add a dashboard panel and set alert: p99 > 135ms for 5m => pause rollout. infra-ci will post canary status.

deploy-bot: canary deployment queued: runtime-canary-2026-03-17-01. Trigger: manual by trevor.

infra-ci: nightly perf run finished — baseline attached to the PR when available. note: one flaky test in batching/continuous_batch_integration, marking for triage.

alex: small ask — please add a short changelog entry about the fallback semantics so product + SRE know what to expect.

maria: thanks all. next steps list: 1) @jin open PR w/ perf numbers and test script, 2) @trevor prepare dashboard + alert, 3) @alex draft revert + rollout plan in PR, 4) @maria will notify SRE and PMs after canary. Ping here when PRs are posted. :thumbsup:

trevor: pinging this thread when dashboard is live.

jin: PR posted: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/3830 — includes perf run and test vectors.

maria: got it, thanks. I'll coordinate the Friday decision meeting if canary looks green.

alex: will write the revert steps in PR now, ETA 30m.

infra-ci: perf baseline attached to PR 3830.

maria: closing the async loop — please update the thread if anything changes.

sasha: noted, will update stake-holders.

deploy-bot: canary deployed by trevor at 2475322400.

trevor: canary green for 30m, p99 stable at 126ms, no KV miss spike. Proceeding to gradual rollout per plan.

maria: awesome — thanks team.
